en: Draw the client's attention to the two-tone execution (gold and nickel), which makes the Nuevitas necklace an entirely versatile styling tool, able to be paired with any other pieces from the client's personal collection.
Recommend Nuevitas to create a vertical focal point. The long chain strands visually elongate the silhouette, an effect that is particularly flattering when paired with knit dresses and turtlenecks.
Emphasise the prestige of the 'multifilo' technique: this piece creates a dynamic, lively sparkle with every movement, lending the look a note of understated, quiet luxury.
